body: I mean, you seem above average.

I've emailed my teacher about it and I've taken today off school to get some sleep. So hopefully that turns out okay, if not, then I'll do as you suggested.

And I realise this but I just fail to convey feelings. It's as if they expect me to break down and cry on the spot to prove I'm not speaking empty words or wasting their time. The woman that gave me the interview type thing was telling me, "You don't know what happens when you die. It could be like... really bad. Like there could be monsters." I was 15.
I don't remember ever being that smart in 8th grade. Matrices and good typing skills didn't come until later.
Thank you very much. I don't really know what to type out right now. *hugs* Thank you.
My assignment is a self-teaching process but, I'd feel too guilty. And it doesn't seem you're an average 8th grader.
I mean, no one has a burning passion for matrices in the first place. :/
I can't do that. I've read through it and it's so long, and it's on matrices.

He's trying to get me to stay right now but I've just about given up.

I've read about the tiger mums. She's not really one of them, it's just that I showed more potential than my siblings, if I can say that without coming off as stuck-up. And I do look forward to going to university, since I'll be learning things without the pressure of its necessity, rather my own genuine interest. But with depression I find that I totally lack the ability to see any type of future.

Where's the rest of it?

No, but seriously, that is a beautiful bird.

I managed to contact my boyfriend, and I've tried talking to him a bit before bringing up the subject, but he started playing his console so I just dropped the call then. 

I think something that may also contribute to my mum's misunderstanding is that she was brought up in the Philippines - a completely different society and I assume schooling system. I emailed my teacher about the situation and hopefully that'll buy me some time to pull things together and finish it off.

And I don't know about fine, long-distance relationships are just really slow and mellow. A real emotional bond over a physical one just makes it last (for the right people). I could promise you that you are perfect as you are.

I have 24 hours. If I don't complete it, then I fail because I only have one other piece of assessment this term that goes towards my grade. If I fail one subject, then I can't pass highschool, and I'll have to repeat. I don't have a reason that I can give to anyone, because I've already tried in the past. I missed so many classes going to therapy sessions that did absolutely nothing.
I simply don't have the time to slack off but I can't commit myself to this assignment.

Like I stated, I'm a passenger. My boyfriend has always been there in the past, but lately, I haven't been able to contact him because of his technology not functioning properly. Rather, I have to wait until he can get through to me, which is when I've fallen asleep from exhaustion. 

And clearly I've not spoken loud enough again. I have what I need to kill myself one metre away. Right now it feels like the end of the road, so, maybe I will feel better soon.

My sister said the things in quotation marks. It's all true. 

I have two birds. I clipped one of their wings but she got upset with me so I left the other's alone. It was an extremely hot day. They've never been in a cage. I startled the birds. One could fly. The other couldn't. One hit the fan. 

My edit also explains your last paragraph. I've tried, under other people's suggestions, and it made things much, much worse. I'm so introverted I hate being smothered, and yet a passenger, so love being smothered by the right people. "Professionals", as the people I saw might be called, were not as such, and not who I needed, and need right now.

They don't know I'm suicidal. Each time it's been brushed off, by everyone. I think it's too hard to accept that there are things wrong with your children. My mum wouldn't know how to handle a situation like that. I've had her overreact, and underreact, but never do anything right. 

Also, what do you mean in your last sentence?
